comment: Gas-giant shading parameters. jets: zonal wind profile as a sum of Gaussians in planetocentric latitude (deg), speed (m/s, System III / IAU rotation, prograde positive) and half-width (deg); all approximate, digitised by eye from the cited profiles. minnaertK: Minnaert limb-darkening exponent (1 = Lambert). turbulence: curl-noise eddy speed, m/s. grs: Great Red Spot search band and vortex shape.

bodies.source: Zonal winds: Porco et al. 2003 (Science 299, 1541) Cassini profile; GRS size and rotation: Simon et al. 2018 (AJ 155, 151); Minnaert k: approximate
Zonal winds: Garcia-Melendo et al. 2011 (Icarus 215, 62); Minnaert k: approximate
Zonal winds: Sromovsky et al. 2015 (Icarus 258, 192); Minnaert k: approximate
Zonal winds: Sromovsky et al. 1993 (Icarus 105, 140) Voyager profile; Minnaert k: approximate
